observations: Photo 0 shows a PlayStation 5 console standing on a floor/ledge with a white DualSense controller in front.
Photo 0 shows the PS5 disc-side area and the controller; no visible model/serial label close-up.
Photo 1 shows the PS5 console with the controller in front; the console face is visible but no readable model/serial text.
No accessories are clearly shown beyond the controller (no cables, box, or extra pads visible).
The seller text says 'PS5 slim with a pad', but the photos do not clearly confirm 'slim' vs another PS5 variant.

claims.claim: Clean PS5 slim with a pad
claims.evidence: Photos show a PS5 and one controller, but 'clean' condition and 'slim' variant are not verifiable from these angles; no close-up of model/serial or ports.

risks.risk: Console variant may not be 'slim' (could be another PS5 model), which affects pricing.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the console model/serial label (or the back/side label) and the ports area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest-value PS5 variant among common used options, since 'slim' is not confirmed.

risks.risk: Functionality not proven (may have faults: disc drive issues, overheating, controller drift, HDMI/USB problems).
risks.proof: A short video of the PS5 powering on, reaching the home screen, and playing a game (or running a disc test if disc version).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / worst-case not working properly.

risks.risk: Missing items (power cable, HDMI cable, stand, original box, extra controller).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (all cables, stand, controller(s), and any accessories).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the console + the single controller shown, with no extra accessories.

risks.risk: Controller condition not proven (stick drift, button issues).
risks.proof: Video showing controller connected and a quick input test (moving sticks, pressing buttons) or a gamepad test screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming controller may need repair/replacement.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the PS5 model/serial label (or back label) to confirm the exact variant.
Video: power on → home screen → quick game launch (and disc test if applicable).
Photo of all included items laid out (power cable, HDMI, stand, controller count).
Video/controller test for stick drift and button responsiveness.
response.reason: The photos confirm a PS5 and one controller, but the exact PS5 variant ('slim') and working condition are not verifiable from these images. Without proof, the price could be materially wrong.
